items.title: t8y2/dbx
items.summary: DBX 是一款仅 25 MB 的轻量级跨平台数据库管理工具，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、达梦等 100+ 数据库，提供桌面端、Docker、CLI 以及内置 AI 助手和 MCP Server 功能。
items.summary_en: DBX is a 25 MB lightweight cross-platform database client supporting 100+ databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, and Dameng, with zero runtime dependencies. It features a built-in AI assistant compatible with Claude, OpenAI, and local Ollama models, MCP Server integration for AI coding agents, and native consoles for message queues like Kafka, RocketMQ, and RabbitMQ. Available as a desktop app, Docker container, CLI, and web version, DBX also offers a sandboxed plugin ecosystem built with a Go/TypeScript SDK.

items.title: Yokka – Simple project management for coding agents
items.summary: Yokka 是一款面向编码 Agent 的简单项目管理看板工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 及任意兼容 MCP 的 Agent。Agent 可自主认领任务、同步进度，并在遇到阻塞时主动询问开发者，完成后提供 PR 链接供验证。用户可在 yokka.ai/try 免账号试用，并提供免费计划。
items.summary_en: Yokka is a kanban-style project management tool designed specifically for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and any agent that speaks MCP. Agents autonomously claim and complete tasks on a live board, log progress, prompt the user when stuck, and finalize work with a PR link for review. A free plan is available at yokka.ai/try.

items.title: Tavus' AI looks, listens, and talks back live
items.summary: Tavus发布了"Griffin"人机交互模型，可在实时视频通话中看、听、回应，交互自然度远超以往。测试显示48%的参与者误认为对方是真人，而此前模型仅2.4%；该模型在NVIDIA的VideoFDB视频对话测试中也接近真人水平，比次优AI模型高出超过1分。目前仅向可信测试者开放Griffin-Lite版本，公共发布待后续推出。
items.summary_en: Tavus previewed Griffin, a "Human Interaction Model" that renders a lifelike avatar capable of hearing, seeing, talking, and reacting in real-time over live video calls—watching and listening instead of waiting its turn. In testing, Griffin-Lite achieved a 48% real-person belief rate among users (up from 2.4% with prior models) and landed within 0.09 points of actual humans on NVIDIA's VideoFDB benchmark, outperforming the next-best AI by over a point. The company is currently sharing Griffin-Lite only with trusted testers to refine safety and disclosure features ahead of a public rollout.

items.title: Your AI forgets what you told it. A memory layer fixes most of it
items.summary: AI助手常因上下文窗口压缩而遗忘用户之前的指示，导致每次会话重新从零开始。作者开发的 HyperMarrow 是一个本地优先的内存层，通过在压缩前将偏好、决策等内容写入本地存储，确保原文可被精确召回而非依赖摘要重放。该方案通过分离记忆类型、本地存储默认配置，使 Agent 能够跨会话持续记住用户指定的技术栈（如 pnpm）等关键信息。
items.summary_en: AI agents repeatedly lose context between sessions because stored transcripts aren't addressable after compaction or session end. Developer created HyperMarrow, a local-first memory layer that solves this by writing preferences, conclusions, and raw data to a persistent local store before any context compaction occurs, separating memory types at write time and ensuring recall returns exact original phrasing rather than summaries. The key design principle is that memory lives on the user's machine and sending context to hosted services requires explicit opt-in.

items.title: VectifyAI/PageIndex
items.summary: PageIndex是由VectifyAI开发的无向量数据库RAG引擎，采用树状索引替代传统向量检索，通过LLM推理实现上下文感知的可追溯检索。其SDK支持本地和云端两种模式，本地索引成本约0.001美元/页，索引构建一次即可复用。该技术无需分块，适用于金融报告、法律文件、技术手册等长篇幅专业文档。
items.summary_en: PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning-based RAG engine that replaces vector databases and chunking with a hierarchical tree index, enabling LLMs to retrieve information by reasoning through document structure like a human would. It operates in two steps—generating a tree-structure index per document, then agentically searching that tree—and supports local mode via its SDK (`pip install -U pageindex`). Local indexing costs approximately $0.001 per page, with a basic model sufficient for indexing and a stronger model recommended for retrieval.

items.title: Show HN: Television – an open source GUI for your agent harness
items.summary: Television是Telepath团队开发的开源GUI工具，目前已开放仓库，此前已服务数百名alpha用户。它作为agent harness的可视化界面，支持Claude Code、Codex、Hermes等多种框架，可让用户在与agent交互时创建和管理artifacts。该系统通过CLI和轻量级服务器运行在Linux或macOS上，并将artifact集中展示在独立客户端或浏览器中。

items.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
items.summary: Sean Parker 正将 Stability AI 转型为音乐AI工具公司，公司于8月底获得 Sony、Warner、Universal 等唱片巨头7600万美元融资，并获授权曲库用于模型训练。Stability 已发布三个新音频模型及AI音乐编辑软件，可根据文本提示生成完整器乐曲目或短片段，即将推出的更新支持用户哼唱旋律或 beatbox 打鼓点来引导生成。
items.summary_en: Sean Parker is pivoting Stability AI toward music professionals after joining the company's $80 million rescue two years ago, securing $76 million in new funding from Sony, Warner, and Universal—including licensing deals for their catalogs used in training. The company has released three new audio models capable of generating full instrumental tracks or short snippets from text prompts, with an upcoming update allowing users to hum melodies or beatbox drum patterns to guide generation.
